name: reconnect_watermarks
description: Android and the hub resume from stored watermarks; Android edits (a rename that supersedes an older entry, a new record, a learned presence) while the iPhone is away. The iPhone relinks at MTU 23 (18-byte chunks, PULL limit 8 / maxBytes 512) and pulls only what is new since its watermark; superseded entries are skipped. Then the hub's library is reset (sync_reset: new dbId). A dbId change closes every session; Android edits while unlinked; both phones relink, see the new dbId in HELLO, reset their watermark and exclusion state for the hub, and every record flows back into the hub, including the Android edit.
